title: 'Cool Like Me' Roll On Perfume
source_observation: Official HTML has an Ingredients accordion and a How to use accordion. The ingredient text includes a generic Oil Base entry plus fragrance components, so it does not establish complete INCI-grade coverage. Media shows front-label/lifestyle/easy-roll-on evidence, but no back-label ingredient panel.
